context: Thread a structured provision-result (ok|skipped_absent|failed{reason}) through _resolve_backend into doctor and the implicit-local write refusal; never log secrets.
description:
Defect found during 2026-08-05 tracker-simplification batch close-out (post #1580).

_when_ no backend is selected, `_try_turso_auto_provision` returns None on ANY mint failure (turso absent, not logged in, nonzero exit, empty token) and `_resolve_backend` falls through to the implicit local DB. doctor then reports "implicit local fallback" with no indication that a mint was attempted and failed. Operators debugging "why am I on local?" cannot tell "turso missing" from "turso present but token mint failed" (e.g. wrong expiration flag, auth expired, wrong DB name).

Desired: when turso is on PATH and a mint is attempted, doctor and the write-refusal path report a distinct WARN/FAIL (mint attempted, reason class: not-logged-in / bad-expiration / empty-output / nonzero-exit) without ever printing the token or full URL. Precedence and hermetic tests that stub turso-absent must stay unchanged.

preserves.behavior: Explicit --db / TODO_DB_PATH / TODO_DB_URL still outrank auto-provision
Hermetic tests continue to stub turso absent by default
Tokens and hosted URLs are never printed or written to disk
